items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the base change of a syntomic morphism is syntomic (statement lines 5838-5841). The counted proof is short and complete: syntomicity is a local property of ring maps, so the assertion is the transfer of the algebraic statement that syntomic ring maps are stable under base change (proof lines 5843-5851). It is H2: the reduction is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the locality verification of the same chapter and the algebraic stability statement.
